entities.summary: Yew-Kwang Ng or simply Kwang is a Malaysian-Australian economist, who is currently Emeritus Professor of Economics at Monash University, and an Honorary Professor at the School of Economics, Peking University. In 2007, he was elected as Distinguished Fellow of the Economic Society of Australia. He was elected in 1981 to be a Fellow of the Academy of the Social Sciences in Australia; and became a Jubilee Fellow since 2021.
